Before replacing an installed binary, stop the city and verify a restored pre-update backup using the [update guide](https://github.com/2youg1/sprawling-agents/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#updating).

The documentation introduces persistent agent teams, long-running work, agent communication, monitoring and custom workflows. README and getting-started content match in English and Chinese; the wire, integration and performance references keep their own detailed contracts. Confirmed security fixes ship with the next release, without backports; vulnerabilities use the private channel listed in `SECURITY.md`.

Use the assets of the selected published tag and the version actually available through your installation channel. Archive checksums, Sigstore build provenance and operating-system code signing establish different facts; a signing application does not establish a signed binary. A repository Nix source build does not establish that nixpkgs has accepted the package or that a channel can install it.
